title: Spicy Thai Lechon Bites
description: Crispy fried bites filled with a flavorful lechon filling, inspired by Thai cuisine.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil to 350°F (180°C) for frying.
2. In a blender or food processor, blend the lechon, beets, fish sauce, and vinegar until well combined.
3. Using your hands, shape the lechon mixture into small balls, about 1 tablespoon each.
4. Dredge each ball in the breadcrumbs to coat.
5. Carefully place the coated lechon balls in the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
6. Remove the fried lechon bites from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the Spicy Thai Lechon Bites hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
